historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 drawings for the multi-purpose building at Storyland, the zoo's children's area, by J. Francis Ward.
The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 drawings for the zoo's African Scene, whose first drawings by J. Francis Ward it had approved on March 1, 1965.
With $7,500 voted by the Board of Supervisors, the Recreation and Park Commission engaged J. Francis Ward, architect, to draw a master plan for the zoo.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build Storyland, a children's attraction at Fleishhacker Playfield, to Hub Pacific Building Company of Menlo Park at $147,750.
